title: 咸阳城东楼
author: 许浑

Poem (semantic reference only, no printed text): 咸阳城东楼 — 许浑
一上高城万里愁，蒹葭杨柳似汀洲。
溪云初起日沈阁，山雨欲来风满楼。
鸟下绿芜秦苑夕，蝉鸣黄叶汉宫秋。
行人莫问当年事，故国东来渭水流。
visualReview: Viewed solitary figure in old tower looking over reed marsh, weathered palace grounds, river and gathering dark clouds near sunset. Wind visible in reeds and hanging branches; historical melancholy retained. Central and lower paper clear, no writing or frame.
